fact_dispositions.prior_value: Updates and renders every fighter's projected-shadow texture for the current camera pass. It selects a scene light, derives a stable light-relative basis, switches fighters to their shadow-specific model profile, rebuilds each shadow's caster list, applies activation guards and stage intensity, fits an orthographic shadow camera around the fighter's camera box, runs the offscreen HSD shadow pass, and finally restores ordinary fighter model visibility.
fact_dispositions.reason: Describe exact local state and delegated boundaries, correcting broad caller, eligibility or renderer claims.

fact_dispositions.prior_value: At the start of each invocation, the routine clears every fighter's capacity-related shadow inhibit bit. A missing or degenerate light sets the no-light inhibit bit and selects a fallback camera basis. For each fighter shadow it removes all prior casters, conditionally registers the visible fighter model and accessory, and sets the no-caster bit when neither is available. The shadow becomes active only when all six LbShadow inhibit bits are clear and the fighter passes the additional eligibility predicate. Camera fitting retries up to twenty rectangle expansions; success installs the fitted viewing rectangle, while exhaustion installs fixed orthographic bounds. Eligible shadows then receive one offscreen render, optionally including the extra black rectangle when the argument is nonzero.
fact_dispositions.reason: Correct ownership/delegation and distinguish flag budget, activation and actual offscreen render gate.
